duplicate_denominator_policy: duplicate excess divided by assets with complete simulation-package fingerprints; coverage is reported against N_eval
movable_joint_policy: all declared XML joint elements whose normalized type is not literal fixed; includes exporter extension types and does not imply runtime-valid DoFs
sample_size_policy: acquired roster (500) is below the N=800 sample size used for larger releases; the full acquired roster enters evaluation with no subsampling, replacement, or outcome filtering
topology_denominator_policy: unique topology hashes divided by assets with valid rooted joint trees; coverage is reported against N_eval
